mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cage_claims ( animal_cage_id, claim_status, claimant_id, claimant_name, claimant_dept, aup_id, assigner_id, assigner_name, confirm_required, retry_count, note, created_at ) VALUES ( #{animalCageId}, #{claimStatus}, #{claimantId}, #{claimantName}, #{claimantDept}, #{aupId}, #{assignerId}, #{assignerName}, #{confirmRequired}, #{retryCount}, #{note}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM cage_claims WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM cage_claims WHERE animal_cage_id = #{animalCageId} AND claim_status IN ('pending_approval','locked','confirmed','pending_release_approval') LIMIT 1

SELECT c.* FROM cage_claims c WHERE claim_status IN
(#{status})
('pending_approval','pending_release_approval')
AND (claimant_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR claimant_dept LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))
ORDER BY c.created_at ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM cage_claims WHERE claim_status IN
(#{status})
('pending_approval','pending_release_approval')
AND (claimant_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR claimant_dept LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))
SELECT * FROM cage_claims WHERE claim_status = 'pending_approval' AND created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{beforeHours} HOUR)
SELECT * FROM cage_claims WHERE claim_status = 'locked' AND updated_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{beforeHours} HOUR)
mapper.update:
UPDATE cage_claims SET claim_status = #{status}, note = CONCAT(IFNULL(note,''), ' | ', #{note}), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id IN
#{id}
AND claim_status = 'pending_approval'
AND claim_status = 'locked'
mapper.select: SELECT cci.animal_cage_id AS animalCageId, cci.position_x AS positionX, cci.position_y AS positionY, cci.shelve_id AS shelveId, ccd.cage_type_code AS cageTypeCode, ccd.project_pi_name AS projectPiName, ccd.aup_number AS aupNumber, ccd.department_name AS departmentName, ccd.project_name AS projectName FROM cage_cell_index cci JOIN cage_cell_detail ccd ON cci.animal_cage_id = ccd.animal_cage_id LEFT JOIN cage_claims cl ON cci.animal_cage_id = cl.animal_cage_id AND cl.claim_status IN ('pending_approval','locked','confirmed','pending_release_approval') WHERE cci.shelf_index_id = #{shelfIndexId} AND ccd.cage_type_code = 2 AND cl.id IS NULL ORDER BY cci.position_x, cci.position_y
SELECT * FROM cage_claims WHERE animal_cage_id = #{animalCageId} AND claim_status IN ('pending_approval','locked','confirmed','pending_release_approval') FOR UPDATE
SELECT si.room_id FROM cage_shelf_index si WHERE si.id = #{shelfIndexId} LIMIT 1
